name: Knock-on effects tracer
why: Traces what a planned structure change causes next and the signs to watch, a check before choosing an option.

name: Problem-first job description writer
why: Writes a role around the problem it must solve, the same habit as the role profiles in the options skill.

name: Quarterly headcount plan keeper
why: Checks the headcount plan against hires and exits, an input to the current structure map.

name: Decision checklist keeper
why: Checks a big decision before it is made, useful when leaders choose between org design options.

name: Define a customer support escalation agreement
why: Writes down who handles a stuck issue and when it moves up, a worked example of decision rights.

name: Plan coverage for a critical role
why: Makes sure each critical task has a backup, a risk check during a transition.

name: One-on-one meeting planner
why: Sets up regular one-to-ones, which matter when spans widen after a redesign.

name: New leader first message writer
why: A first message for a leader taking on a new or merged team after the change.

name: Power and fear map builder
why: Maps who holds influence and what they fear, useful for the stakeholder step of a transition plan.

name: Employee feedback action review assistant
why: Tracks actions agreed after staff feedback, with small groups kept private, for the after-change check.
